title: Echoes of AI Harms: A Human–LLM Synergistic Framework for Bias-Driven Harm Anticipation

bias_targets.methodology: Factorial vignette-based survey experiments where human and LLM annotators evaluate domain-specific scenarios (hiring and healthcare) exhibiting non-representative training data to identify anticipated downstream harms.

Factorial vignette-based survey experiments where human and LLM annotators evaluate scenarios exhibiting poorly defined proxies or inaccurate features to map them to perceived harms using a structured taxonomy.

Factorial vignette-based survey experiments where human and LLM annotators evaluate scenarios illustrating flawed model design choices or underfitting to identify corresponding harms across diverse stakeholder groups.
Factorial vignette-based survey experiments where human and LLM annotators assess harms resulting from models validated on unrepresentative benchmark datasets.
Factorial vignette-based survey experiments where human and LLM annotators identify harms caused by AI systems used autonomously or in contexts misaligned with their intended design.
